answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 40230 Country: India Title: I want to know the difference between one talaq bain and two talaq bain. Is there any different Question: I want to know the difference between one talaq bain and two talaq bain. Is there any different? Does one talaq bain completely break the marital relation in khula or still 2 more talaq bain will be required to break so. Answer ID: 40230 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1177/748/L=1433) In khula, nikah comes to an end completely by one talaq bayin. After one talaq bayin, there is no need of two more talaqs for termination of nikah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
